protocol.selection_rule: Stage 1: min validation pinball loss. Stage 2: max mean lift of the recommended window measured against the supported-window baseline (both scale-free across bucket geometries and immune to winner's-curse regression), tie-broken by top-1 positive-lift rate, NDCG@3, lower no-claim rate, then support. The no-claim cap of 0.9 filters candidates when any candidate satisfies it; if none does, the miss is recorded instead of aborting.
protocol.bucket_size_comparison_note: NDCG@3 is not comparable between 3h (8 candidates) and 4h (6 candidates) geome-tries, which is why the geometry decision rides on the observed lift of the recommended window instead.
